description: A private ranked condition resolves #(A<$GOOD ¬$BAD>) before ≇ and rejects the reading. The signed-constants pattern matches A under engine §§2 and 10 and §2.1.
grammar:
%const $GOOD Extra
%const $BAD Blocked
%rule text ($x:A ≻ never) :: ∅
%conditions ($x ⟹ $x ≇ #(A<$GOOD ¬$BAD>))
%rule never Z
